crossRefs.note: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron, and spoke, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand…
After this, the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his place.
It will happen in that day, that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples. All who burden…
Behold, a day of Yahweh comes, when your plunder will be divided within you.
I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the…
and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them…
They went up over the width of the earth, and surrounded the camp of the saints, and the beloved city. Fire came down…

translations.web: All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.
translations.bsb: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
translations.kjv: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy
translations.asv: All nations compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.
